name: Curved Text Scroll

source.notes: Inspired by Clueso Social — city names on a circular path with fixed dot indentation

prompt: City names arranged on a vertical circle (like a wheel). The wheel rotates to scroll text. Each line is rotated to follow the tangent of the circle, creating a curved text effect. A fixed blue dot stays in place; only the single item directly in front of the dot gets indented outward.
